FieldValue.description: One distinct value of a field.

count.description: Features holding it (those read, when the listing is incomplete).

label.description: The label of its first feature, when a label field is given.

several_labels.description:
Its features carry more than one label (AccessMod 5 refuses such a
road table).

description:
Distinct values of a field of a vector layer, e.g. the classes of a
road layer and their labels.

complete.description:
False when the layer has more than [`MAX_VALUES`] distinct values:
reading stopped at the first value over, and `values` holds the
ones met before it.

values.description: Values, numbers ascending, then text, then `null`.

title: FieldValues
